ios.desc:
ColorGrams is the best tangram puzzle app in the app store. There are countless fun puzzles to do, with literally unlimited content because you can create your own puzzles and share them for the world to play! 

All the standard Tangram shapes are there, but you're not restricted to the standard 7 pieces. Each puzzle is unique and fun and now's your chance to show off your artistic and puzzle making skills.

There are three main components to this awesome game:

1. Puzzle Challenge - Take on over 100 classic and not-so-classic tangram puzzles.

2. User Created Puzzles - Try an unlimited amount of puzzles created by other players like you, and rank them by quality and difficulty.

3. Create - Make whatever you want with whichever pieces you want in the super fun Puzzle Creation mode and upload them for other players to try.


If you pay to unlock Pro Mode, there is no limit to how many puzzles you can solve and create.

If you notice any inappropriate content, please contact me on Twitter @CodyRMace
